title: Graceful shutdown for the API server
description:
Deploys currently cut off in-flight requests: on SIGTERM the process exits immediately and clients see connection resets (OPS-301).

`server.Run` now stops accepting connections on SIGINT/SIGTERM and gives in-flight requests up to 20s to finish (our cluster kills pods after 30s). Tests cover draining an in-flight request and reporting a port that is already taken.
